text:
Situation: Levetiracetam 100 mg/mL is not on FDA's drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21. Corvale East holds 124 eachs at 6.8 per day for 18.2 days on hand. Corvale General holds 177 eachs at 7.8 per day for 22.7 days on hand. Corvale Lakeside holds 55 eachs at 2.1 per day for 26.8 days on hand.

Why (FDA record): FDA's records show levetiracetam is not on the drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21.

Our position: Current inventory across three sites provides 18 to 27 days of supply. No FDA shortage listing exists. Proactive purchasing from approved manufacturers not on the shortage list will maintain supply continuity.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to place orders with Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC (plant last inspected VAI 2023-10-13) — approved by pharmacy director.
2. Buyer to qualify Hospira, Inc. as secondary source — approved by pharmacy director.
3. Buyer to qualify Mylan Institutional LLC as tertiary source — approved by pharmacy director.
4. Buyer to monitor daily usage and adjust reorder points weekly — approved by pharmacy director.
5. Buyer to report supply status to P&T committee monthly — approved by P&T chair.

Not recommended: No allocation restrictions, therapeutic substitutions, or emergency purchases at this time.
